balls.text: pitched up and outside off, this cutter from Curran lands in the slot, sliced in the air, but does not carry to Moeen at deep third man
on a length and floated away outside off, yet another cutter from Curran. Shami misses another leg-side hack
sliced in front of sweeper cover. Cutter, Curran takes it wide of off. Shami reaches out for the ball, slaps it in the air, and comes back for the second
on-pace back-of-a-length delivery on middle, hauled away to deep midwicket
make that another cutter outside off, 120.1ks, Shami swings so very hard that he loses his shape and misses

No fifty for SRK, he holes out to Jadeja. Banged in short and outside off, offcutter once again from Curran, asks SRK to manufacture his own pace. SRK pulls and ends up splicing it in the air off a top edge. Jadeja runs in from deep midwicket, then runs to his left, and snaffles it
cutter it is, short and finishes wide of off, off-side wide
big dipper from DJ. Floated down the leg side, chasing Shami who was backing away to the leg side. Shami has another leg-side hack but does not touch it
low full-toss on middle, hauled away to the left of deep midwicket. Moeen makes a smart diving save to his left in the outfield
slower cutter at 104ks, wobbles down leg as Shami swings...and misses again
lifter on middle, Shami can't hook it away. He can't put bat on ball
full-toss outside off, belted away to the left of Bravo, plinked down to long-off
back of a length and angling into middle, Shami hangs back and works it to deep midwicket
Thakur digs it short and outside off, SRK looks to send it over midwicket with the pull. Instead, he top-edges it over Dhoni's head. Not middled, but gets the result he was looking for
yorker, tails in at off, jammed through midwicket as SRK dashes back for the second
slower delivery wide of off, just inside the tramline, SRK slashes and is beaten
on a length and wobbles away outside off, SRK loads up for a big swing...and misses
full and wide of off, Shami reaches out for the ball and slaps it away to the left of sweeper cover
pinged to the right of sweeper cover. Seam-up length ball outside off, SRK thrashes it through the line
full and Thakur aims to take it away from SRK's swinging arc. He pushes an off-side wide
Bravo hits a heavy length, the line is outside off, Shami wafts it to point with an open bat-face

Ashwin holes out to Faf in the infield. He can't clear mid-off. Back of a length and holds its line outside off, Ashwin is a bit early into the loft, he picks out one of the best fielders in the CSK side
yorker on middle and leg, whipped to deep midwicket
excellent ball-striking from SRK! 108ks slower ball outside off, SRK manufactures his own pace. He reads the variation and golf-swings it straight of long-on
slower ball outside off, drilled straight back to Bravo
back-of-a-length seam-up delivery, bunted off the back foot through midwicket
wide of the crease, slower-ball, not sure if that was the knuckle ball, lashed through the cover-point region
slower-ball bouncer outside off, does not rise as much, Ashwin ignores it
banged in short and outside off, Ashwin chops it only as far as point
wide yorker, squeezed away to deep point
shot, SRK! He's giving the Kings some hope. Hip-high short ball outside off, seam-up stuff, SRK camps back and powers a pull over midwicket. He's showing everyone that he belongs to this stage
short, wide, SRK latches onto the width and scythes a cut to the right of sweeper cover
back of a length and drifts away outside off, Ashwin opens the bat-face and dabs it behind point
dipping offbreak outside off, Ashwin reaches out for it and drags it to midwicket off the inner half
whipped off the pads to Jadeja at deep square leg
shorter and spins into middle, Ashwin hangs back and finds a single on the leg side
quietly worked to midwicket with the spin

Bam! SRK muscles it over midwicket for six. He lines up a tossed-up offbreak on middle, slog-swept with the spin over the leg side. Kumble likes it and applauds that six. He likened SRK to Pollard ahead of this season
full ball, starts on middle and spins away, patted to the covers
speared into the pads, Ashwin flicks and finds midwicket
flat and quick on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket
sliced in the air but wide of cover and backward point
flighted on middle, driven wide of Jadeja. He flings to his left from his followthrough and stops the ball
slower and outside off, tip and run to cover
dragged down on middle, SRK jumps back and heaves it on the bounce to Jadeja at deep square leg
on a length and spinning in at off, defensive lengths from Moeen, tapped straight to midwicket
dragged down outside off, hauled away to deep midwicket off the back foot
tapped down to long-on with the spin
darted in at off, Ashwin opens the face and dabs it to point

Moeen Ali darts a slider, fired full on middle, seems to gather more pace after hitting the pitch. It's nowhere near short enough for the pull. Richardson misjudges the length and searches for the pull. He misses it altogether. Moeen hits the stumps
down the track, Jadeja pushes it shorter on middle, whisked down to wide long-on
darted in flat ay middle, fuller and faster, defended to midwicket
shorter and spins away outside of, Richardson jumps back, gets on top of the bounce and punches it handsomely through extra-cover with the spin
arm ball, fizzes into middle, squirted to point
sliding into off, takes the inside edge and rolls down to mid-on
tossed up on off, pushed back to Jadeja
shorter and sliding in at middle, Richardson hangs back and whips it through the vacant spaces at midwicket
hard-length offbreak, stabbed back to Moeen
SRK ventures down the track, Moeen drags it shorter and gets it to spin at off, forced down to long-on
back of a length and spinning into middle and leg, clipped off the back foot to deep midwicket
on a length and turns into middle and leg, confidently worked with the break through square leg
looped up and spinning in at off, SRK presses forward and dabs it back to the bowler
back of a length and fired into off, stabbed to midwicket off the back foot
another round-arm dart, fired down the leg side, left alone
round-arm dart, attacking the stumps, whipped through midwicket
flat and quick, sliding in at off, played back to Jadeja
picked off the pads to fine leg
on a length and outside off, patted to cover
arm ball, fizzing in to hit the pad, this is heading down leg with the sharp angle
cracking shot on the off side! Width on offer again, and SRK frees his arms with a crisp back-foot drive that beats Chahar in the deep. Chahar tried to stop with his right leg but the ball raced away
142.6kmh, short and quick outside off, SRK wants to smash it with a pull but misses it
on middle and leg and Richardson tucks it away towards deep square leg
fullish outside off and he drives it away to deep point
width on off this time and Richardson runs it down to third man
too full on the pads and Richardson flicks it away nicely in the vacant region in deep midwicket. Boundaries on the last two balls will lift PBKS
poor and rare short ball from Jadeja, SRK pounces on it with a pivot on the back foot and pulls it for six over deep midwicket
forward lean and he defends on off
goes on the back foot to turn the back of length ball to leg and he's off the mark as well
touch fuller and he pushes it down to long-off
beats him outside off with some turn. Length ball middle and off, nice turn beats the outside edge
length ball on the stumps, defends it back
a maiden to end his spell, excellent bowling from Chahar. Richardson pushes the length ball into the covers and Chahar finishes with 4-1-13-4
drags the length back a fair bit and Richardson stays back to defend it on off
nice straight-bat cover drive with a forward lean to mid-off this time
drives away from the body and cover-point slides to stop it
chipped straight to mid-off! Such a soft dismissal this one. Regular swinging delivery lands on the seam outside off, hint of away swing and Hooda merely gives some catching practice to du Plessis
in the channel outside off and Hooda helps it to point
moves across a bit and steers this back of length ball to deep point for one
crisp cover drive from Hooda, and the cover fielder dives to his right to save a few
pumped over extra-cover! Back of a length and holds its line outside off, no swing, Hooda jumps on top of it. Punched on the up for four
Jadeja in the action again! Back of a length and outside off, forced straight to him at cover-point
on a length and swinging into off, worked straight to Jadeja at short midwicket

nip-backer from Chahar, he is confident that he has his man. Not given out lbw. Dhoni opts against a review. Nice and full, starts outside off, and veers in to strike the pad. Was it doing too much to threaten the stumps?

This is a cracker of a powerplay for CSK! Pooran holes out for a duck. Shoulder-high short delivery outside off, gets big on Pooran. He looks away, takes his eyes off this lifter, and pulls it straight into the lap of Thakur at long leg.
short and sliding across off stump, Pooran lets it pass

Jadeja shows Gaikwad how to take catches. The Boss is gone now. Knuckle-ball variation, finishes around off stump. Gayle is early into the drive, and ends up scooping it in the air. Jadeja swoops to right from short cover, dishes out a full-length dive, and hangs onto the ball even as he lands on his elbow. He makes it look ridiculously easy
back of a length and largely holds its line outside off, forced to the left of mid-off
Curran tests the Boss with a bouncer, he ducks under it. Dhoni collects it in front of his chest
shorter and outside off, swatted away off the back foot to the left of long leg
back of a length and skipping away outside off, carved in the air...but doesn't carry to point
shorter and angling across off stump, Hooda jumps back and fends it off to mid-off
fuller and closer to off, draws Hooda forward into a skittish push to cover
full and sliding across off, this doesn't swing as Curran takes it away from Hooda with the angle. Left alone
full and bends away outside off, Hooda opens the bat-face and dinks it down to deep third man
short and shoved down the leg side for a wide

pitches outside leg and swings to strike the pad. The muffled lbw appeal is shot down. Gayle may have eked an inner edge onto the pad But, hey, Jadeja (who else?) swoops down on the ball from short cover and nails the stumps at the striker's end to catch Rahul short. Rocket throw. Gayle doesn't do these super-fast singles/leg-byes. Rahul pushes him through, opts against diving, and he loses his wicket in the end
pitched up and angling away outside off, a crease-bound Gayle sends an inside-edge to midwicket
Chahar draws the inside edge, Dhoni tumbles to his right to stop the ball. Much fuller and holds its line outside off, Gayle simply throws his bat at ball

edged and the outside edge flies over Raina at slip. Chahar pulls his length back and gets it to slant away from Gayle with some extra bounce. He swings, aiming leg side, and carves it to the third-man fence
picked up and flicked over square leg. Stylish stroke from the Boss. Full and veering into the pads, picked up and put away
Curran hits a hard length and brings this back in towards off stump against the angle. Rahul leans back and punches towards mid-off
inswinger, finishes on the pads, duly picked away fine. The man in the deep is very square. First boundary this evening
on a length and angling away just a shade outside off, bunted to mid-off
length-ball inswinger, finishes around middle, Rahul gets forward and pushes it defensively to the leg side
Rahul jumps on top of this short ball angling across him. Punched straight to extra-cover
near-yorker length delivery, bends in at middle, swing for Curran too. Jammed out

full and wide of off, swings away, Gayle reaches out for the ball and carves it in the air. Gaikwad drops the catch to his right at backward point. That was a fairly regulation chance although it travelled quickly to the infielder
yorker, swinging into off stump, Gayle jabs his bat down and keeps it out

Chahar castles Agarwal with a beauty and lets out a big roar. Fuller than a good length, starts around middle stump, and nips away just enough to ping the top of off stump. The late shape opens up Agarwal and messes with his balance. There's the early wicket for CSK. Agarwal wafts to the leg side and misses. He goes for a two-ball duck
back of a length and largely holds its line outside off, Agarwal inches forward and steers it towards point
back-of-a-length outswinger, finishes just a shade outside off, Chahar coaxes Rahul into a hard-handed jab in the channel. An inside edge skips away past leg stump
starts off with a good-length delivery that shapes in slightly at middle, Rahul shuffles back and across in defence
Curran finishes it off with a four! Hip-high short ball on leg stump, Curran jumps across and hauls a pull between long leg and deep midwicket
short and angling across off, guided to short third man
hard-length delivery, angling across off, edged behind to Rahul
full and straight, tucked to deep midwicket
inswinging yorker on off, pushed down to long-on
short of a length and sliding across off, Curran sizes it up and punches through the line to sweeper
yorker, homing in at leg stump, 140ks, squirted down to long-on

two in two for Shami! Banged in short and outside off, Rayudu advances down the track. He aims to pump it over covers, instead he slices it squarer. Pooran runs in from point and pouches it. They check for a possible no-ball for height, but this was fine. To add to it, Raina had stepped out
Raina jumps across off stump this time, Shami bangs a bouncer on middle, climbing towards the shoulder. Raina looks away, takes his eyes off the ball, and flaps a pull behind to Rahul
Raina backs away outside leg, Shami follows the moving batsman with a short ball, which is top-edged over midwicket
short and outside off, hauled away to deep midwicket

Rahul thinks Faf has gloved it behind to him. The on-field umpires Chaudhary and Dandekar referring it to the TV umpire Sharma to check whether this was the second bouncer this over. Banged in short and slanting away from the shoulder, Faf hooks as the ball bounces over his left shoulder. Deemed a fair delivery. The TV umpire then asks Chaudhary to give it out even before checking for DRS. A bit of chaos. They now check for DRS: no bat, no glove involved. Not out: right call in the end
Raina shuffles outside leg once again, Meredith chases the moving batsman with a short ball. Flapped to deep square leg
back of a length and shoved down leg, offcutter, Raina is early into the pull as the ball dribbles behind to Rahul, probably off the back of the bat
banged in short and bounces over the stumps. Raina shuffles outside leg stump, throws his bat at ball, but it's still away from his reach
bumper down the leg side, Raina sinks under it
bumper aimed at the head, Raina ducks out of the way. Wide called for height
shorter and sliding across off, forced off the back foot to the left of sweeper cover
languidly driven past the bowler. Tossed outside off, Raina stretches out and belts it away straight of wide long-off
flat and fired across off, another googly, beaten outside off
M Ash comes back and has Moeen holing out to SRK at deep midwicket. Another googly, pushed through on off, Moeen has a slog-sweep at it even before it turns. He picks out the outfielder
wide wrong'un, Moeen reaches out for the ball and does not connect with it
Moeen Ali: spin basher. M Ash tosses it too full on middle, lands it in the swinging arc of Moeen. He clears his front leg and swipes this attempted wrong'un over wide long-on for six
Moeen rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and guides a single to deep third man
back of a length and angling in, chipped in the air, but does not carry to SRK at long-on
overpitched and outside off, slower ball goes awry, Faf lunges forward and creams a cover-drive

down the track and spliced to mid-off. Faf gets it high on the bat and finds Pooran. The West Indian has a shy at the striker's end, and misses. Away from Rahul and away from Shami in the outfield. Faf gets four in the end
cutter outside off at 109ks, Faf swishes and misses in the channel
fuller and slanting into middle, whipped away into the leg side. Gayle throws himself to his right to stop the ball. Jonty Rhodes seems pleased with the Boss' effort
pumped away to the right of mid-off. Shami overpitches it outside off, Moeen leans into it and punches it through the line
yorker on middle stump, jammed back to the bowler
full on the stumps, whipped away to the left of SRK at long-on
back of a length on middle and leg, jabbed back to the bowler
sweet clunk as Moeen swats it away to the right of deep midwicket. Another short ball angling across off him, not short enough, Moeen camps back and dispatches it away
lifter, angling across off, catches Moeen in a tangle. He hops, and fends at it, before the ball fizzes past his bat
another shorter one outside off, Moeen camps back and whips it to wide long-on
googly, short, wide, scythed away to the left of sweeper for a double
tossed up slower and fuller on middle, driven back to the bowler
googly from M Ash, but too short and wide, flayed down to long-off off the back foot
fired down the leg side, Moeen can't get bat on sweep, leg-side wide
fuller, faster, this slider is clipped from an off-stump line to deep midwicket
legbreak, short, finishes too wide. Faf latches onto it and cracks a cut to the left of sweeper cover
cutter from Meredith, he cuts his pace down to 116ks, Moeen drives early and chips it in front of the bowler
Meredith pounds it on a heavy length and gets it to seam back in at Faf, inside-edged down to fine leg
another offcutter, 122ks, fullish and outside off, Faf delays the drive and ends up scooping the ball to mid-off
banged in short at the arm pit, fended off to the leg side. Moeen gets across to the other end
slower ball, cutting away outside off, Moeen swishes early and misses this offcutter
...Moeen welcomes him back with another drilled drive. Full and outside off, Moeen latches onto it and crunnnnnches it through the covers
wrong'un, from wide of the crease, Faf works it away between fine leg and deep square leg
full-toss outside off, driven to the right of long-off
another googly from Ashwin, but the length is shorter, allowing Moeen to punch it wide of sweeper cover of the back foot
follows the googly with the legbreak, finishes on leg stump, blocked to the leg side
there comes the googly from M Ashwin. Pushed through flatter, quicker, draws a healthy outside edge, but just eludes Gayle at slip
back of a length and skids on outside off at 91ks, stabbed through midwicket off the back foot
on-pace short ball outside off, Moeen hauls it in the air, gets it over short midwicket, and pings the boundary
slower ball, defended on off stump
shortish and sliding into the body, Moeen hops and fends it off to the leg side
Faf waits for this slower offcutter and dabs it down to deep third man
on-pace short ball outside off, not enough room for Faf to free his arms. Slashed straight to point
Arshdeep digs another slower cutter into the pitch, does not come onto Faf, he drags an inside edge that rolls past the stumps
Moeen picks the gap once again. Sweet as... On a length and angling away outside off, Moeen presses forward, gets closer to the pitch, and caresses it away between cover-point and point
well-directed lifter, angling away outside off. Moeen drops his gloves and lets it zip through to Rahul
back of a length and nipping away outside off at 142ks, Moeen chases and does not make contact
fine response from Meredith. He pulls his length back and gets it to swerve away past Moeen's outside edge
laced away between covers and mid-off. 142ks, very full and just a shade outside off, driven on the up and in the gap
he pounds it on a heavy length and gets it to move away outside off, stabbed into the covers

Gaikwad picks out Hooda at deep midwicket. Arshdeep puts him out of his misery. Banged in short and outside off, shoulder-high offcutter, Gaikwad drags a pull against the angle and hits it straight into the lap of Hooda
Gaikwad finds Pooran once again. He continues to struggle for placement and timing. Another short ball angling across him, steered straight to the infielder
shortish and angling across off, Gaikwad leans back and laces it straight to Pooran at point
back of a length and slanting away outside off, Faf jumps back and taps it in the gap at covers. Offcutter from Arshdeep
slower ball, shorter and outside off, Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce, dabs it to cover and sets off to the other end
on a length and angling away, jabbed into the covers. Gaikwad aims to cross over to the other end, but Faf rightly sends him back. No single there
on-pace length ball outside off, Faf knows fine leg is squarer. So, he jumps across off and delightfully scoops it away fine of long leg for six
good length and seaming in at middle, Faf stoops low to keep it out
back of a length and sliding into the pads, picked off fine of long leg for four
more attacking intent from Faf. Down the track, hacked to mid-on off the inner half
here comes Faf: down the track and belted between mid-off and cover. The ball isn't coming on, but Faf can manufacture his own pace
on a fuller length and zipping back in at middle, 139.7ks, Faf squirts it out cover
pretty full and outside off, jabbed into the covers for one. Another slow start in the powerplay for CSK, but they can afford this tonight
Shami draws a leading edge but it not carry to cover. Fullish and straightening away a touch, Gaikwad eyes up the leg side and gets away
pitched up and slanting into off, Faf drives a single to the right of mid-on
back of a length and holds its line outside off, this ball slides onto the angled bat of Gaikwad. Dinked down to deep third man
back of a length and seaming in from outside off, Gaikwad has a hard-handed waft away from the body and almost plays on
full and darted wide of off, Gaikwad reaches out for the cover drive with his hands as an inside edge wanders away to mid-on
recoils away from the ball as he defends it on and around off stump. The seam movement away, and a little kick off the pitch, tells Faf this ain't gonna be easy
cuts a shortish delivery to cover point

in the air....but safe!. Gaikwad steps out of his crease wafts at a length ball wide outside off - meant to be too far for him to reach. In the end it comes off the very bottom of the bat, but lands safely with cover point running to his right and back, and cover running to his back
nudges a good length ball on middle and leg towards mid-on
blocks a good length ball that straightens off the pitch in front of off stump.
pings the pads again, only this one was there to be put away. Faf misses the glance for four to fine leg and has to settle for leg byes

gets it to straighten off the deck and squares up Gaekwad again. The batsman is looking to flick through midwicket and gets struck on his back thigh. Half an appeal for lbw. Too high. Encouraging first over from Shami for the Punjab Kings.
blocks a shortish delivery on off stump towards the covers
reaches away from his body and gets an inside edge as he attempts a cover drive. Wanders off to the keeper.
thuds into his bat as Shami hits back of a length on middle and leg, Faf finds a single behind square leg
cuts back in and raps him on the pads but Shami pulls out of the appeal. Prolly a bit too high. But sensational movement off the pitch. Had the batsman pinned on his crease. Good signs
pitches it up on off stump, the ball nibbling into the right-hander at the last. Gaekwad tries to push to mid-off but gets an inside edge to mid-on instead
